method: Krita CLI exported an OpenRaster copy into .godot/classroom_instructor_access/source-layers.ora. Each foreground uses nonzero alpha coverage from its original paint layer, and copies RGB/alpha from the existing saved composite at the same canvas coordinates. Composite edge pixels are retained as-is, without resampling or repainting. Zero-coverage pixels stay transparent.
preservation: Source KRA and original composite unchanged. Artwork-only runtime equals the original composite over black at all 1,228,800 pixels. Re-export silhouettes when the normal artwork changes; these are static normal-state foregrounds.
